market.domesticSlice: India enzymes market: $440.5M (2023), CAGR 7.8% (2024-2030); industrial enzymes held 54.7% share of the India enzymes market in 2023; the India market is consolidated, with top players holding 75%+ share

structureFacts: Enzymes are positioned as sustainable substitutes for harsh industrial chemicals — more reaction-specific, lower-toxicity by-products — used in textile bleaching, pulp/paper bio-bleaching, biodegradable detergents
Cold-water detergent adoption in North America and Europe amplifies detergent-enzyme demand, since enzymes catalyze cleaning at 20-40°C where conventional chemistry underperforms
EU green-chemistry policy actively supports enzyme adoption in detergents, food processing and agri-biotech

adoptionStructure.note: Not a seasonal-repurchase category; enzymes are a recurring consumable input tied directly to customer production volumes (detergent formulators, textile mills, food processors reorder as they manufacture)

peers.name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies
peers.note: ~10x Infinita's revenue scale — a scale-differentiated rather than direct peer; 2nd-highest market share among Indian enzyme companies, present in 70+ countries

drivers: consistency of enzyme activity/potency batch-to-batch — the core quality metric
technical support for dosing/process integration into the customer's own manufacturing line

steps: develop custom blends per customer process requirement
plan production against customer order volumes
customer production run creates recurring consumable demand
purchase order placed against production volume
reorder tied to customer's own manufacturing cadence
